concept_data:
## Game Identity
- Title: SMACK
- Platform: PC (Steam)
- Genre: vertical-ascent momentum game [PROPOSED]
- One-liner: bounce from jellyfish to jellyfish to reach the surface before the current pulls you back down.
- Source: Smack.pdf (p.1)
core_loop:
## Core Loop
Launch → time bounce on a bell → chain clean smacks (combo) → avoid tentacles → beat the current to the surface.
design_pillars:
## Pillars
1. **Flow over Perfection** — momentum matters more than pixel-perfect precision.
2. **Living Cathedral** — every jellyfish reacts; none are static props.
3. **The Sting is Learned** — tentacles punish, but always telegraphed.
4. **Rise, Never Rush** — grace beats speed; speed without grace is penalized.

Anti-pillars: not a rage-game; not procedural-first; not beat-locked.
Feel statement: "like exhaling through a chandelier of light." [PROPOSED]
economy_design:
## Economy
None (premium SP title). No currencies, no IAP. [PROPOSED]
encounter_design:
## Encounters
Named patterns: The Curtain, The Chandelier, The Gauntlet, The Bloom. One signature encounter every 100m.
environments_x4:
### ENV-01 Abyss (−500m→−300m)
Dark, sparse jellyfish.
### ENV-02 Twilight (−300m→−100m)
Medium density, first colorful species.
### ENV-03 Reef Ceiling (−100m→−20m)
Extreme density, hazard zone.
### ENV-04 Surface (−20m→0)
Light through water, climax.
faction_map:
## Factions
None. The Current acts as an invisible antagonist manifested as descending particles. [PROPOSED]
feedback_system:
## Feedback
Tentacle telegraphs 400ms [TUNE]; combo = visual intensity + music layers; depth = darkening.
hud_layout:
## HUD
Near-invisible: best height (corner), combo (diegetic under player), depth as screen-edge gradient — never a number.
item_catalog:
### ITEM-01 none
No inventory items at launch. Species = collection layer, not items. [PROPOSED]
level_map:
## Level Structure
Curated base layout per biome; jellyfish spawns randomized within rules, seeded. [PROPOSED]
mechanic_specs:
### MEC-01 Bell Bounce
Timing window 180ms [TUNE]; perfect window 60ms [TUNE] → 1.25× height [TUNE].
### MEC-02 Tentacle Slip
Brush = −15% velocity [TUNE]; direct hit = 2m knockback [TUNE], no death (Pillar 3).
### MEC-03 Combo Flow
Each clean smack ×1.05 score [TUNE]; decay 2s [TUNE].
### MEC-04 Depth Pressure
Per 20m below best height: darkness +5%, velocity ceiling −10% [TUNE].
### MEC-05 Surface Rush
Final 50m: no tentacles, music climax, decorative bell bloom.
narrative_arc:
## Arc
Descent (tutorial) → Ascent (main) → Surface (climax). No dialogue, no cutscenes.
player_stats:
## Stats
Velocity, best height (persistent), combo multiplier. No RPG stats.
progression_sys:
## Progression — Blooms
Each run permanently unlocks jellyfish species (15 at launch [PROPOSED]); progression = variety, not power.
world_lore:
## World
A glowing ocean cathedral. Silent narrative — told through biome design only.
